data.title: The poster by the window

memoryNodes.cue: Sam reduces the glare on the poster.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 萨姆减弱海报上的眩光。

memoryNodes.cue: The campaign asks about patterns in everyday life.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 宣传活动询问日常生活模式。

memoryNodes.cue: A visitor asks what a talk will cover.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 访客询问讲座会介绍什么。

data.situation:
Sunlight fell across the last poster and made it difficult to read. Sam pulled the curtain partway across the window to counteract the glare. The poster was part of a campaign to promote healthy living. It asked visitors how much of an ordinary day they spent sitting. One paragraph used sedentary lifestyle to describe a pattern with a great deal of sitting and little physical activity. Visitor: I made a conscious decision to walk here today. I wanted time away from my desk.
Sam: Was that the reason you came to this display?
Visitor: Yes. I am interested in how people maintain a healthy body, though one poster cannot answer everything.
Sam: There is a leaflet about the centre’s talks beside the window. You can ask the organisers what each talk covers.

readingBlocks.en: Sunlight fell across the last poster and made it difficult to read. Sam pulled the curtain partway across the window to counteract the glare. The poster was part of a campaign to promote healthy living. It asked visitors how much of an ordinary day they spent sitting. One paragraph used sedentary lifestyle to describe a pattern with a great deal of sitting and little physical activity.
readingBlocks.zh: 阳光照到最后一张海报上，让文字难读。萨姆拉过一部分窗帘，减弱眩光。海报属于一个促进健康生活的宣传活动，问访客平常一天坐着多久。一段文字用“久坐的生活方式”描述坐着很多、体力活动较少的生活模式。

readingBlocks.en:
Visitor: I made a conscious decision to walk here today. I wanted time away from my desk.
Sam: Was that the reason you came to this display?
Visitor: Yes. I am interested in how people maintain a healthy body, though one poster cannot answer everything.
Sam: There is a leaflet about the centre’s talks beside the window. You can ask the organisers what each talk covers.
readingBlocks.zh:
访客：今天我是有意识地决定步行来的。我想离开书桌一会儿。
萨姆：这是你来看这个展示的原因吗？
访客：对。我对人们怎样保持身体健康感兴趣，不过一张海报不能回答所有问题。
萨姆：窗边有中心讲座的传单。你可以问组织者，每场讲座介绍什么。

glossary.note: counteract an effect；本例非治疗，不承诺身体作用。
glossary.example: Sam drew the curtain to counteract the glare.
glossary.exampleZh: 萨姆拉窗帘以减弱眩光。

externalEvidence.definition: oppose and mitigate the effects of by contrary actions

glossary.zh: 倡导或促进健康生活方式
glossary.note: aim to promote表达目的，不宣称效果已证实。
glossary.example: The campaign aims to promote healthy living.
glossary.exampleZh: 宣传活动旨在倡导健康生活。

glossary.zh: 久坐、体力活动较少的生活方式
glossary.note: a sedentary lifestyle；本例说明生活模式，不诊断个人。
glossary.example: The poster describes a sedentary lifestyle.
glossary.exampleZh: 海报描述一种久坐的生活方式。

glossary.zh: 有意的；经过自觉考虑的
glossary.note: a conscious decision/effort；本例不是伤者清醒的意思。
glossary.example: The visitor made a conscious decision to walk to the centre.
glossary.exampleZh: 访客有意识地决定步行到中心。

glossary.note: maintain表示保持状态；这里表达讨论话题，不给个人方案。
glossary.example: She is interested in how people maintain a healthy body.
glossary.exampleZh: 她对人们怎样保持身体健康感兴趣。
